reason: Fresh clone of bounded-systems/synoptic @ be917d0 into /tmp/final/synoptic-1; `git am` of the regenerated single patch applies cleanly (9 files, +247/-15, commit body carries `Closes #1`). I read every sentence of the ready-to-paste comment against the tree and found no false statement. Confidence stays medium for the same two reasons as before, neither of which a fix round can remove: nothing has executed on real WebKit (the macos-14 job is unexecuted; only Chromium proof exists), and the vendored engine's equality with the npm tarball is still unverifiable here (npm/jsr blocked; the file traces to pamelafox/axe-playwright-python@88c601d) — both are honestly disclosed and assigned to the owner.
